exposure.definition: distance in the observed induced graph to an exact-count boundary node <= maximum_propagation_power - 1; empty for zero propagation power

aggregation.primary: unweighted mean of per-unit rates, matching the E18 overall table; NA groups excluded with explicit defined_units

aggregation.coverage_decomposition: mean of within-unit exposed/non-exposed certified counts divided by all test nodes; do not multiply marginal averages
